acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider professional surface smoothing for your Pasadena property when you notice uneven floors, walls with significant imperfections, or if you plan to install new flooring or paint. This is particularly important for commercial spaces where a high-quality finish is expected, or in residential areas where maintaining property value is key.
